# Prompt Engineering Guide

> > A comprehensive open-source guide to prompt engineering techniques, LLM optimization, and AI agents by DAIR.AI

This guide covers fundamental and advanced prompting techniques including Chain-of-Thought (CoT), Zero-shot CoT, and practical implementations across models like Gemini and OpenAI. Created and maintained by DAIR.AI and contributors including Elvis Saravia, with resources for both beginners and practitioners building RAG systems and AI agents.

## Key Topics

- Chain-of-Thought (CoT)
- Zero-shot CoT
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- AI Agents
- Prompt Engineering
- LLMs (Large Language Models)
- Gemini
- OpenAI
- Few-shot Learning
- Prompt Optimization
- DAIR.AI
- Pretrain, Prompt, Predict
- Multimodal AI

- [Prompt Engineering Guide | Prompt Engineering Guide](https://www.promptingguide.ai/): Homepage for DAIR.AI's guide on LLM prompting techniques and AI agents
- [About | Prompt Engineering Guide](https://www.promptingguide.ai/about): About DAIR.AI's open-source Prompt Engineering Guide project

## Prompting Techniques

- [Prompting Techniques | Prompt Engineering Guide](https://www.promptingguide.ai/techniques?ref=retool-blog.ghost.io): Overview of LLM prompting techniques and optimization methods
- [Chain-of-Thought Prompting | Prompt Engineering Guide](https://www.promptingguide.ai/techniques/cot): Guide to Chain-of-Thought and Zero-shot CoT reasoning techniques

## Model Guides

- [Getting Started with Gemini | Prompt Engineering Guide](https://www.promptingguide.ai/models/gemini.en): Guide to Google Deepmind's Gemini multimodal AI models
